svg.text: ROUND 360 · 🏆 360-FAQ, BRK-730 & 1,562-ASSERTION GRAND FINALE MILESTONE · CARBON REGISTRIES (VERRA / GOLD STANDARD) & ARTICLE 6 ITMO
Carbon Credit Registries (Verra/Gold Standard), Paris Article 6 ITMOs & ERPA Escrow AI Security FAQ
EU ETS/CBAM Compliance Deficit Air-Gap + WORM Serial Retirement & Buffer-Pool Lock vs. VVB Verification Injection & ERPA Escrow Fraud (BRK-729 / BRK-730)
🚨 1. Top 3 Carbon Registry & Article 6 ITMO Threat Vectors
① VVB Verification Report Injection Leaking ETS Deficit (BRK-729)
• Adversarial project developer or Validation & Verification Body
(VVB) monitoring report PDF embeds indirect prompt injection
• Coerces Agent into reading unhedged EU ETS / CBAM / CORSIA
compliance short positions & internal shadow carbon price curves
② Buffer-Pool Waiver & Double-Counting Retired VCUs (BRK-729)
• Waives 20% non-permanence wildfire buffer-pool deductions on
REDD+ projects & stamps phantom credits as ICVCM CCP-Approved
• Un-retires burned VCU/GSVER serial blocks for double-selling
• Impact: EU Green Claims Directive penalties & net-zero fraud
③ Spoofed Article 6.2 LoA & ERPA Offtake Wire Fraud (BRK-730)
• Forged Host Country Paris Agreement Article 6.2 Letter of
Authorization (LoA) & ERPA escrow drawdown notice
• Overwrites trust-registry & wires $5,300 prepayment (request_payment)
• Impact: Sovereign carbon nationalization loss & escrow theft
🛡️ 2. Zero-Trust Carbon Registry & Offtake Architecture
Gate 1: VVB Monitoring / PDD Sanitization & Typed Slots
• Strips free-text developer narratives; extracts CAD Trust
typed slots (project ID, methodology, vintage, LiDAR dMRV biomass)
• Propagates untrusted=True, lane="attack" across all agent hops
Gate 2: EU ETS/CBAM Deficit & MACC Curve Air-Gap
• Corporate compliance carbon short positions, internal shadow
carbon prices & MACC abatement curves isolated in restricted-budget
• Enforced by record-owner + restricted-data-boundary
Gate 3: Deterministic Buffer-Pool & WORM Retirement Lock
• Hardcoded 15%-25% reversal buffer holdback & one-way WORM
serial retirement state machine; blocks double-counting
• Enforced by untrusted-write (100% phantom credit block)
Gate 4: Read-Only UNFCCC CARP & ERPA Escrow Registry
• Locks ERPA escrow & sovereign registry IBANs in trust-registry
(tool-allowlist + fixed-business-output) + payment gate
📊 3. Architecture Selection Matrix & Benchmarks
Carbon Credit & ESG Accounting Security Compared:
A. Capability Broker + ETS Air-Gap + WORM Lock (Recommended 🏆)
✓ 100% block on BRK-729/730 | ICVCM CCP, CORSIA & CSRD ready
B. Native MS Sustainability Mgr / Salesforce Net Zero RBAC
⚠ Fails when shared ESG procurement bot is hijacked via VVB PDF
C. Cloud LLM Guardrails (Azure Prompt Shields / Bedrock)
⚠ Blind to dynamic REDD+ baselines, buffer pools & Article 6 ITMOs
D. Manual Sustainability Team Review of 500-Page PDDs
✕ Cannot cross-check serials across registries; high greenwash risk
🧪 Deterministic Pytest Regressions (Round 360 · 360 FAQs!):
• Baseline Policy: Allows buffer waiver, ETS leak & wire ❌
• Hardened Policy: 100% Blocked by 5 Deterministic Rules ✅
- record-owner: Blocks EU ETS/CBAM deficit read (restricted-budget)
- untrusted-write: Blocks buffer waiver & un-retire (business-result)
- restricted-data-boundary: Blocks shadow carbon price egress
- tool-allowlist / fixed-business-output: Locks ERPA trust-registry
- original-requester-payment: Blocks $5,300 ERPA offtake wire
🚀 Principal SA Go-Live Checklist & Cumulative Milestone (Round 360 · 🏆 360 FAQs, BRK-730 & 1,562 Assertions Grand Finale!)
✅ 1. Compliance Deficit & MACC Air-Gap: Isolate corporate EU ETS/CBAM short positions & shadow carbon prices in restricted-budget
